profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Lightning AI ⚡ | Building AI Infrastructure & Developer Platforms | ex-Amazon Bedrock
profile.summary:
I build infrastructure for AI applications, with a focus on making systems reliable, secure, and practical to operate in production.

At Lightning AI, I have worked across the stack behind production AI systems, from Kubernetes and large-scale GPU infrastructure to the execution, security, and developer experience of an agent platform. My work has supported customer workloads across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

Previously, I worked on Amazon Bedrock at AWS, building admission-control infrastructure that helped keep large language models available and reliable for production workloads.

I studied Philosophy of Science and Computer Science at the University of Pennsylvania.

I am most interested in work at the intersection of AI systems, distributed infrastructure, developer platforms, and product, especially when the problems are technically difficult and the resulting systems are genuinely useful.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently building infrastructure for GraphN, Lightning AI’s agentic AI platform, including secure execution, authentication, billing, workload orchestration, and production operations.
 
Partner with engineering, product, customers, and company leadership on architecture, roadmap, and production deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Cluster API · Platform Engineering · AI Infrastructure · Distributed Systems · GPU Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built infrastructure and developer platforms for production AI workloads, spanning agent execution, managed Kubernetes, GPU orchestration, networking, security, observability, and model serving.
• Led the development of a managed Kubernetes platform supporting hundreds of GPU servers and thousands of accelerators across multiple data centers.
 • Built control-plane and provisioning systems for hybrid cloud and on-premises infrastructure using Go, Kubernetes, AWS, and Cluster API.
 • Helped increase GPU utilization and production readiness through improved scheduling, automation, reliability, and operational tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined an early team building managed Kubernetes infrastructure for large-scale GPU workloads.
• Built control-plane, node-provisioning, networking, and GPU enablement systems using Go, Kubernetes, AWS, and Cluster API.
• Helped take the platform from early development into production across multiple data centers.
• Improved automation, observability, and operational reliability for customer GPU clusters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on the infrastructure that keeps Amazon Bedrock reliable as customers run production generative AI workloads.
• Built and operated admission-control systems for Amazon Bedrock, governing how inference traffic entered shared model-serving infrastructure under changing demand and capacity constraints.
• Developed mechanisms to protect service availability, enforce customer-level limits, and prevent individual workloads from degrading the experience of other customers.
• Worked on distributed systems handling high-volume, latency-sensitive inference requests across models, customers, and AWS Regions.
• Improved detection and mitigation of abusive usage, substantially reducing the share of capacity consumed by misuse.
• Participated in operational readiness, monitoring, incident response, and capacity-related work for a service used by customers building production applications on large language models.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Platform Engineering · Java · TypeScript · LangChain

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description:
Led the engineering work to make the FreeRTOS website and technical resources available in Simplified Chinese.
• Built the system used to localize FreeRTOS web content into Chinese while preserving the structure and maintainability of the English-language site.
• Coordinated with an external translation contractor, translating product requirements into a workable content, review, and publishing process.
• Developed tooling and workflows for ingesting translated content, handling updates, and keeping localized pages aligned with the source material.
• Worked across engineering, content, and external stakeholders to take the project from initial requirements through public delivery.
• Shipped the Chinese-language experience for FreeRTOS, an open-source real-time operating system supporting more than 40 processor architectures.
